D_day_strike.execution: Two small/medium packets attack fire-support and transport lanes rather than one large daylight mass. C6N/D4Y reconnaissance is protected for recontact.
D_day_strike.US_ship_damage: No old-battleship or fast-carrier mission kill. One LST/APA/AKA-class transport-support hull receives medium damage; one destroyer/LCI-type escort receives light-to-medium damage; several landing craft are lost/damaged.

reconnaissance.result: A surviving fast reconnaissance aircraft obtains a broad fast-carrier sector east of Saipan late in the day; uncertainty remains roughly 70-120 nmi and the report ages before reaching the Mobile Fleet.
reconnaissance.use: Improves 16 Jun search-axis selection but is not a 15 Jun weapon-quality strike fix.

end_15Jun.interpretation: The local air system can still scout and generate small strikes but can no longer sustain theater air defense. Surviving attack/recon assets are deliberately husbanded for 16-17 Jun.
